forecasts.rationale: Fortune had ETH at $2,261.87 on 2026-11-03 and OKX showed about $2,301 on 2026-11-04 (unverified), so $2,600 is roughly 13-15% above spot with about 4.5 days left in the window (https://fortune.com/article/price-of-ethereum-11-03-2026/, https://www.okx.com/en-us/price/ethereum-eth). With a typical ETH daily move near 3%, that is more than two standard deviations of the five-day move, and FXStreet and Zebpay on 2026-11-03 describe a bearish channel, ETF outflows and rejection at the $2,309 realized price (https://www.fxstreet.com/cryptocurrencies/news/ethereum-price-forecast-us-led-selling-keeps-eth-below-2-309-realized-price-202611032321). A single 1-minute high counts, and the Nov 6 payrolls print could spark a squeeze, so a small tail is left; no Nov 2-3 high near $2,600 is reported.

forecasts.rationale: BLS reported 6.3% year-over-year for September 2026 (https://www.bls.gov/news.release/ppi.nr0.htm, 2026-10-15), so 6.8% needs about 0.5 points more, meaning October's not-seasonally-adjusted monthly rise would have to beat the unconfirmed October 2025 base month by roughly that much. Retail gasoline fell about 20 cents over October (https://gasprices.aaa.com/2026/10/), which points to a smaller energy contribution after September's 10.8% energy-goods jump, though crude readings conflict ($92 to $114) and core rose 0.7% in September. Such a further acceleration is rare outside energy shocks, but the September print surprised far above a reported 5.3% consensus, which keeps the upside tail alive.

questions.question: Will PPI YoY be 6.8% or more in October?
questions.resolution_criteria:
This is a market about the Producer Price Index (PPI) for final demand over the 12-month period ending October 2026, before seasonal adjustment, as reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

This market will resolve to the percentage change in the Producer Price Index (PPI) for final demand over the 12-month period ending in October 2026, before seasonal adjustment, according to the monthly Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) report.

The resolution source for this market will be the BLS Producer Price Index report released for October 2026 (https://www.bls.gov/ppi/), currently scheduled to be released on November 13, 2026, at 8:30 AM ET. Resolution of this market will take place upon release of the aforementioned data.

Note: the resolution source for this market will be the official monthly BLS PPI news release, which reports PPI over 12-month periods to only one decimal point (e.g., 6.0%). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market. This market resolves on the total PPI for final demand figure, not the core PPI figure excluding food and energy.

If the BLS does not release the relevant figures on the scheduled date, this market may remain open up until the scheduled release time of the next PPI report (https://www.bls.gov/schedule). If the information is not released by that time, this market will resolve according to the figures of the most recent previous month with available data.
